description: This file contains implementations of binary search functions for object IDs and hashes within a Git repository, including detailed comments on the binary search algorithm and specific functions like oid_pos and bsearch_hash.

methods.name: take2
methods.description: Extracts a 16-bit value from an object ID hash at a given offset.

methods.name: oid_pos
methods.description: Performs a binary search to find the position of an object ID within a table, or the insertion point if not found.

methods.name: bsearch_hash
methods.description: Performs a binary search on a hash table to find a specific hash and returns its index.
